title: Need backup power on the go? The BLUETTI Elite 10 Mini is 40% off right now
summary: BLUETTI’s Elite 10 Mini drops to $119 at Amazon, bringing portable backup power to travel, camping, and short outages.
body: Amazon has cut the BLUETTI Elite 10 Mini Portable Power Station to $119, down from its $199 recommended retail price. That saves you $80, which is a 40% discount off the RRP, and makes this compact backup battery a lot more tempting right now. See the deal at Amazon
